tax_rule_versions_calc_shape.name: tax_rule_versions_calc_shape
tax_rule_versions_calc_shape.value: ("app"."tax_rule_versions"."calc_kind" = 'fixed' and "app"."tax_rule_versions"."amount_fc" is not null and "app"."tax_rule_versions"."amount_fc" >= 0) or ("app"."tax_rule_versions"."calc_kind" = 'percent_of_base' and "app"."tax_rule_versions"."rate_bp" is not null and "app"."tax_rule_versions"."rate_bp" >= 0)

receipts_cancel_shape.name: receipts_cancel_shape
receipts_cancel_shape.value: ("app"."receipts"."status" = 'issued' and "app"."receipts"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("app"."receipts"."status" = 'cancelled' and "app"."receipts"."cancelled_at" is not null and "app"."receipts"."cancelled_reason" is not null)
